system.description:
You have a pathological reliance on a drug ▶330, stimulus (e.g., XP, VR), or activity (e.g., mesh use, dying) to a degree that impacts your physical or mental health. 

Addiction comes in two forms: mental (affecting the ego) and physical (affecting the biomorph). Work with your GM to choose an addiction that is appropriate for your game. 

You must indulge in your addiction at a regular frequency according to the level or go into withdrawal. Withdrawal inflicts a –10 modifier per level.

Level 3: Once per 6 hours. You face major cravings, live for your next fix, and are on the road to ruin.

To get more information consult pages 76 following
